outcome_summary: Delivered two final feature areas for the x4-savegame-parser and x4-savegame-parser-launcher projects: (1) a `log-metadata` PHP CLI command that stores and returns log category metadata (id/label/count) from analysis.json, consumed by a refactored dynamic LogbookView dropdown in the React frontend; (2) a Rust `setup.rs` module providing `download_and_install_tools` and `check_for_updates` Tauri commands, consumed by a new SetupWizard React component in SettingsView. All 4 WPs passed full pipeline stages with zero test regressions; PHP PHPStan level 6 and TypeScript compilation both clean.
